title: Outer probability of an event
statement: Given a learning program with either random-example access or query access, a Boolean target on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and an event in the product of the program’s output space with its learning cost, its outer event probability is the outer measure—under the program’s run distribution with that target—of the set of output-cost pairs satisfying the event.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $n$ specifying the input dimension
A program with that access mode and an output type
A Boolean target on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
